name: Snakes
overview: Scripture presents snakes as symbols of both danger and wisdom. The serpent in Genesis 3 is cunning and deceptive, initiating mankind's fall, yet God declares enmity between the serpent and the woman's seed, pointing to Christ's ultimate victory. Proverbs and Micah depict serpents as creatures that can inflict harm and evoke fear, while Jesus instructs His followers to be wise as serpents yet harmless as doves, emphasizing prudent discernment combined with innocence. Additionally, Mark records that believers will have authority over serpents and protection from deadly substances, highlighting the power granted through faith.
